messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Metoprolol is FDA-approved to treat high blood pressure, angina, heart failure, and heart attack.
The two forms are not approved for the same conditions.
Condition | Metoprolol tartrate (immediate release) | Metoprolol succinate (extended release)
High blood pressure (hypertension) in adults | Yes | Yes
High blood pressure in children 6 years and older | No | Yes
Angina (chest pain) | Yes | Yes
Heart failure | No | Yes
Heart attack (myocardial infarction) | Yes | No
High blood pressure (hypertension).
Lowering blood pressure reduces the risk of fatal and non-fatal heart and blood vessel events.
These events mainly include strokes and heart attacks.
Metoprolol can be used on its own or with other blood pressure medicines.
Many people need more than one medicine to reach their blood pressure goal.
Angina.
Metoprolol is used for long-term treatment of angina.
It is used to reduce how often attacks happen.
It is used to help you do more before chest pain starts.
Metoprolol is not used to stop an attack that has already begun.
Heart failure.
Triplet: ["Metoprolol", "fda approved to treat", "heart failure"]

The relation 'fda approved to treat' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is approved by the FDA for the treatment of the medical condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'fda approved': The subject entity has been approved by the FDA, as indicated by the object entity.
C. 'has related treatment guide': The subject drug is associated with the medical treatment guide specified by the object entity.
D. 'related to': The subject drug is associated with the medical condition or disease specified by the object entity.
E. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
